extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n for real n, then f'(x)=nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[cf(x)] = c f'(x) for constant c.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Derivative Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(e^x)=e^x and d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation Rules
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules for computing derivatives of polynomial and exponential functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Unique number with lim_{h->0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function with base e; it equals its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponential function with base a; derivative is a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form a^x, including e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponent n that can be any real number in the Power Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A fixed number such as c in the Constant Multiple Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The limiting value used to define the number e.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function whose derivatives use the Power, Sum, and Constant Multiple Rules.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Instantaneous rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interpretation of the derivative in real-world problems.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of position: v(t)=s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of velocity: a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function s(t) whose derivative is velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of cost: MC=C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function C(x) whose derivative is marginal cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse operation of differentiation; also called integration.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation/integration.
